shots.note: wide push_in: Brahma sits on his lotus in a gold cosmos; on 'रचा' he opens his arms and a golden egg of creation glows above while orbs fly out to become worlds.
medium pull_out: An empty temple courtyard with a cold altar; Brahma stands alone under the arches and lowers his eyes on 'पूजा', a cold dim falls on 'नहीं'.
close push_in: Close on Brahma in shadowy violet: his eyes slide sideways and his face turns guilty on 'झूठ', the riddle's answer shown on the guilty face.
insert tilt_down: A ketaki flower tumbles down through violet clouds; on 'गवाह' its little face looks up frightened: the witness is introduced.
wide crane_up: Brahma with the flower in his hand and Vishnu stand small at the foot of a blazing gold column; the fire lights their faces from the middle.
establishing tilt_up: An extreme wide frame: the column runs off the top and bottom of the screen while the two gods are tiny specks beside it.
low_angle handheld: The column splits and Shiva bursts out of the fire with blazing red eyes; his name appears as it is spoken and he points with his left hand.
two_shot pull_out: Two-shot: Shiva stands over Brahma who bows in shame under a red storm; the frozen poses say the judgement is final.
establishing crane_down: The three gods stand side by side on clouds in a sky court: Brahma left, Shiva centre, Vishnu right, all calm, a halo ring opens on 'तीन'.
medium push_in: Brahma on his lotus in a gold cosmos; his name appears as spoken and on 'रचते' glowing orbs leave his hands as new worlds.
medium pan_left: Vishnu stands on the moonlit cosmic ocean, his name appears, and on 'पालते' he raises his hand in blessing while his chakra glows.
low_angle tilt_up: Shiva on moonlit Kailash, his name appears and on 'संहार' his eyes harden while embers rise: destruction as his duty.
medium dolly_right: In the sky court Indra, Agni and Surya turn to each other in surprise as the news reaches them on 'ख़बर'.
two_shot push_in: Brahma left and Vishnu right face each other on a darkening cloud ridge; on 'झगड़ा' both scowl and Brahma points.
wide dolly_left: Indra, Agni and Vayu hurry from left to right across the clouds toward the noise, then stop and stare on 'देखा'.
close dutch: Tight two-shot of Brahma and Vishnu nose to nose in red light, both faces in rage with heavy brows.
wide pull_out: Wide on the court: the two gods shout, the devas cower at the edges, and on 'ग़ुस्सा' the storm turns fully red with shockwaves between them.
ots push_in: Over Vishnu's shoulder Brahma stands in the warm court and speaks, pointing at the path behind him on 'रास्ते'.
two_shot pan_right: Vishnu stands upright with folded calm and his eyes turned away, while Brahma beside him glares; on 'प्रणाम' Brahma's face hardens.
low_angle tilt_up: Low angle on Brahma: he lifts his hand in pride on 'रचयिता', then opens his arms indignantly on 'सम्मान'.
medium dolly_left: Vishnu turns round to face Brahma on 'पलटकर' and replies with an open hand, his eyes steady.
close push_in: Close on Vishnu, chest out, the Sudarshan chakra flares behind his shoulder on 'पालनकर्ता'.
two_shot pan_left: Brahma steps forward and jabs his finger at Vishnu on 'रचता', the court reddening behind them.
medium dutch: Brahma alone in a dutch frame sweeps his arm across the empty sky on 'कुछ नहीं', mocking an empty universe.
medium crane_down: Vishnu holds a small glowing globe of the world in his open hand and looks at it tenderly on 'नाज़ुक'.
wide push_in: A memory opens: the asuras Madhu and Kaitabha lunge with sword and mace over the cosmic ocean, their names appear as spoken.
medium handheld: Vishnu hurls the spinning chakra; a flash and shock ring hit the two asuras who fall flat.
two_shot pull_out: Back in the court, Vishnu lays a hand on his chest and lifts his chin on 'बड़ा', Brahma scowling at the edge.
close push_in: Close on Brahma as the insult lands: his face flushes to rage on 'शक्ति', thunder cracks far behind in a red sky.
wide dolly_right: Brahma strides from left to right toward Vishnu on 'आगे', then snaps 'शक्ति' with a raised hand.
close pull_out: Close on Brahma's three faces, eyes narrowed in challenge; a golden glow swells behind him on 'देखना'.
low_angle tilt_up: Low angle on Brahma opening his arms; a swirl of golden energy turns inside his halo and a beam opens like a door on 'आओ'.
medium push_in: Vishnu walks into the golden doorway of light in Brahma's chest and fades into it on 'गए'.
establishing pull_out: Tiny Vishnu stands on a cloud in a gold cosmos looking up at countless glowing worlds circling; on 'लाख' a swirl of worlds turns.
wide pan_right: Inside Brahma: dark-blue waves rise and crash over rocks, spray flying; Vishnu small on a rock watching.
establishing tilt_up: Huge snow mountains rise through the clouds; the camera tilts up their faces while tiny Vishnu looks up at them.
wide dolly_left: A green valley full of life: villagers, a child sage and a swan among flowering trees, petals drifting; Vishnu smiles on 'जीवन'.
insert push_in: A glowing golden womb-egg pulses in amber light; on 'तत्व' four element orbs of fire, water, air and earth circle it.
wide crane_down: A dark violet void with drifting mist; a faint yantra slowly appears inside the emptiness on 'राज़' while tiny Vishnu peers into it.
two_shot pan_left: Back in the court Vishnu steps out of the light beside Brahma, still dazed, and turns to speak.
medium push_in: Vishnu folds his hands to Brahma on 'स्वामी'; Brahma lifts his chin and smiles proudly.
two_shot pull_out: Vishnu opens his arms and a deep blue glow swirls in his chest on 'भीतर'; Brahma's smile falters into doubt.
medium crane_down: Brahma walks into the blue swirl at Vishnu's chest and fades into it on 'उतरे'.
close static: In a deep blue cosmos Brahma freezes, eyes wide and mouth open in shock on 'थम'.
establishing tilt_up: Tiny Brahma on his lotus at the bottom looks up at a vast glowing infinity sign filling the blue cosmos.
wide orbit: Spiral galaxies turn across the whole frame, near and far, in violet and gold.
low_angle pull_out: Brahma on his lotus is dwarfed by a giant ringed planet glowing above him; light rings ripple on 'झिलमिलाते'.
medium pan_right: Three glowing clocks float in the violet cosmos; Brahma's eyes move from one to the next as each part of time is named.
wide pull_out: One golden universe-egg glows, then many more appear across the dark on 'अनगिनत'.
close push_in: Close on Brahma's head as extra faces sprout on every side, all eyes darting in fear on 'देख'.
medium dutch: Brahma clutches his heads in a tilted, spinning cosmos; red-violet swirls spin behind him on 'समझ'.
wide crane_up: Vishnu's great serene face glows faint and huge in the cosmos above tiny Brahma, who looks up.
medium push_in: Brahma on his lotus closes his eyes and joins his hands on 'खोकर'; soft gold rays open above him on 'पाया'.
high_angle pull_out: Brahma, standing, turns left and right searching; a whirlpool churns around him and the cosmos darkens on 'नहीं'.
medium tilt_up: A green-gold lotus stem of light rises from the bottom; Brahma floats up along it on 'डंडी'.
wide crane_up: Vishnu reclines on the serpent over the ocean; a lotus rises from his navel and Brahma appears seated on it.
close pull_out: Brahma on the lotus, eyes calm and soft, divine rays falling, a memory of his first birth.
two_shot push_in: Back in the sky court Brahma and Vishnu stand apart, each with a glowing halo, chins raised in pride.
wide crane_down: A crack splits the cloud floor between them on 'जड़' while the sky reddens, the two glaring across it.
close static: Tight two-shot, both faces lit evenly, gold on one side and blue on the other: equal and both right.
two_shot pull_out: Both gods turn their backs on each other on 'मानने', arms crossed in refusal.
medium tilt_down: A golden balance hangs in the dim sky with fire on one pan and a lotus on the other, perfectly level, between the two turned-away gods.
two_shot dutch: Vishnu lifts the spinning chakra and Brahma raises a burning yantra on 'हथियार', both in rage.
wide handheld: The devas Indra, Surya and Agni stumble back in fear, the whole frame shaking.
two_shot push_in: The two gods lunge at each other from both sides; a white flash bursts in the gap between them on 'बीच'.
wide pull_out: The storm melts into a colossal gold column of fire; both gods fall back with shocked faces on 'प्रकट'.
insert crane_up: Insert on the column: rolling golden flames, embers streaming upward, divine rays.
low_angle tilt_up: Low angle up the column into the sky, then down: tiny Brahma and Vishnu crane their heads upward on 'ऊपर' and down on 'नीचे'.
establishing tilt_down: Top-down tilt along the endless column: it runs out of frame both ways, clouds above and below, no end visible.
wide static: Brahma, Vishnu and the devas stand still before the column, all faces in wide-eyed surprise.
medium push_in: Indra steps forward with the other devas behind him and raises his hand to speak the challenge on 'शर्त'.
high_angle tilt_down: Vishnu at the column base looks down as a glowing crack opens in the ground beneath the fire on 'जड़'.
low_angle tilt_up: Brahma at the column looks up and points to its top, a light glowing far above on 'चोटी'.
two_shot crane_up: A gold crown hangs above the column between the two rivals who look up at it hungrily on 'बड़ा'.
medium pan_left: Brahma and Vishnu nod once to each other with a short bow on 'मान'.
medium push_in: Vishnu glows and dissolves; the blue Varaha boar with gold crown takes his place on 'वराह'.
wide crane_down: Cross-section of the earth: the boar tunnels down through glowing strata, rocks flying, cracks spreading.
medium pull_out: Brahma glows and becomes the white Hamsa swan with gold crown on 'हंस', against a bright morning sky.
wide crane_up: The swan beats its wings and climbs diagonally through layers of cloud as the camera cranes up with it.
wide tilt_up: The swan bursts above the cloud sea into blazing sunlight on 'पार'.
medium dolly_left: Underground, the boar digs on through darker strata, roots and stones.
medium dolly_right: Above, the swan flies on through endless clouds, wings beating.
establishing tilt_up: The column of fire fills the frame top to bottom; the tiny swan beside it is still far from any top.
wide pull_out: A huge cross-section: the column runs from deep earth strata at the bottom up to the clouds and stars at the top.
wide orbit: The column runs vertically through a turning cosmos of galaxies like a backbone holding everything.
medium pan_left: In dusky sky the swan glides slowly with drooping wings, beginning to turn back down on 'लौटने'.
low_angle tilt_up: The swan lifts its head; high above, a small glowing object drops toward it on 'गिरता'.
insert push_in: Close on the ketaki tumbling in the air, cream-gold bracts and its little face, its name appearing as spoken.
medium dolly_right: The swan swoops and closes its orange beak around the ketaki on 'पकड़'.
two_shot push_in: Brahma, back in his own form on a cloud, holds the ketaki up to his face and asks it, eyebrows raised.
close tilt_up: Close on the ketaki talking, eyes lifted toward the pillar's glow far above on 'ऊपरी'.
medium tilt_down: The flower drops down past the fire column, petals loosening, on 'फिसल'.
medium pan_right: Brahma holds the flower but his eyes drift away from it, not listening, as it keeps talking.
close push_in: Close on Brahma: his eyes widen and freeze on 'अटक' as a glow forms by his ear.
extreme_close static: The words 'ऊपरी ऊँचाइयाँ' float in gold above Brahma's head as his eyes look up greedily.
medium crane_down: The ketaki falls past the top of the fire column against dark sky.
low_angle tilt_up: Brahma looks up the column toward a bright glow at its top, eyes narrowing in realisation on 'ऊपर'.
medium push_in: Brahma lifts the ketaki in his hand and turns it, studying it.
insert crane_up: Insert on the ketaki glowing; a gold crown fades in above it on 'जीत': the flower means winning.
low_angle pull_out: Brahma holds the flower high like evidence, a sly smile and narrowed eyes, a halo ring of false glory behind it.
medium dutch: A red void swirls behind Brahma; dark smoke curls around him and the frame tilts on 'चाहत'.
close push_in: Close on Brahma's face half in shadow: a thin scheming smile as the light dims.
two_shot dolly_left: On a dusky cloud top Brahma holds the flower close and jabs a finger at it on 'गवाही'.
low_angle tilt_up: Brahma points straight up to the top of the pillar on 'चोटी', the flower looks up with him.
close handheld: Close on the trembling ketaki in Brahma's grip, eyes wide.
close push_in: The ketaki speaks up, frightened and shocked, its eyes on Brahma.
low_angle tilt_up: Low angle on Brahma towering over the flower, a stern proud face with a hand on his chest.
two_shot pull_out: Brahma softens into a pleading smile, palms out, the flower in front of him looking away.
extreme_close static: Extreme close on the ketaki: sad eyes brimming, its petals trembling.
medium crane_up: Brahma lifts the flower high; a gold crown glows above his head on 'महानता' and his eyes shine with ambition.
close tilt_down: The ketaki lowers its face in shame and gives a small nod; its glow dims.
wide crane_down: Brahma, holding the flower, descends through dusky clouds beside the fire column.
wide pan_left: At the column base Vishnu waits with the devas Indra and Agni, tired and dusty from the dig.
medium push_in: Vishnu lowers his head and bows on 'झुकाकर', palms open in honest admission.
close static: Close on Vishnu: sad eyes, a small shake of the head as a crack glows faintly below him.
close pull_out: Brahma smiles slyly; his extra faces sprout around his head on 'चारों' and all of them start talking.
two_shot tilt_up: Brahma raises his hand high describing the climb; the devas follow his finger upward on 'छुआ'.
low_angle push_in: Brahma spreads his arms in triumph, chin high, a warm glow behind him.
ots dolly_right: Brahma holds out the ketaki toward Vishnu and the devas on 'बढ़ाया'.
close push_in: Close on the ketaki speaking with a forced smile, its eyes sliding guiltily aside on 'महान'.
two_shot pull_out: Vishnu sighs and joins his hands in namaste on 'जोड़' while Brahma smirks beside him.
wide handheld: Wide on the column with Brahma, Vishnu and the devas before it; the ground rumbles and the fire flickers.
medium push_in: The column splits down its centre with a white flash and a shockwave; the screen jolts.
insert pull_out: A great golden Om glows in the crack of the column with rings of sound spreading out on 'गूँज'.
wide tilt_down: The sky behind the cracked column turns from violet to blood red on 'लाल' while flames roar at the base.
low_angle crane_up: Through smoke in the red crack a dark figure rises up out of the fire on 'प्रकट'.
low_angle push_in: Shiva steps out of the fire in rage with glowing red eyes, his name blazing above; thunder in the far sky.
ots dolly_left: Over Brahma's shoulder Shiva lunges and points straight at him on 'उँगली'; Brahma shrinks back.
extreme_close handheld: Extreme close on Shiva roaring with lightning behind; a red flash on 'झूठे'.
wide static: Brahma, Vishnu and the devas stand frozen with open mouths; the ketaki in Brahma's hand droops.
two_shot dolly_right: Shiva walks toward Brahma, who leans back holding the flower, eyes down in fear.
wide push_in: Shiva stands between Brahma and Vishnu and looks from one to the other on 'दोनों'.
establishing tilt_up: The cracked column glows pure white-gold as divine rays pour from it, the words 'शिवलिंग' and 'ज्योतिर्लिंग' named.
wide orbit: A golden infinity sign and a turning yantra glow in a gold cosmos.
high_angle crane_up: Tiny Brahma and Vishnu look up at the blazing column with awe-struck faces.
medium pan_right: Shiva, calmer now, speaks with an open hand toward the pillar.
top pull_out: High-angle: the two rivals are tiny specks at the foot of the giant column.
low_angle tilt_up: Shiva raises his hand to the sky on 'ऊपर'; rays fall from above.
wide crane_down: Brahma, Shiva and Vishnu stand in a row on clouds, golden threads joining their halos to one light above on 'बराबर'.
two_shot push_in: Shiva turns kindly to Vishnu who bows with folded hands; soft blue light on Vishnu.
two_shot dutch: Shiva swings to Brahma with anger, eyes blazing; Brahma flinches in fear on 'डरे'.
close tilt_down: Close on Brahma looking down in shame, a tear forming.
close push_in: Close on Shiva's stern face, eyes steady on Brahma, light slowly falling on him.
low_angle handheld: Shiva lunges and drives the trishul into the ground on 'मारा'; a shockwave and cracks spread, the frame shakes.
medium static: Shiva stands upright, calm but stern, holding the trishul, speaking evenly.
establishing pan_right: A wide valley of nature: river, trees, mountains under a steady sun with a yantra of order glowing in the sky.
close push_in: Close on Brahma with eyes down, shame burning on his face.
wide dolly_left: The devas turn their backs on Brahma one after another on 'नकारेंगे'.
wide pull_out: In an empty temple Brahma's shrine stands dark: the altar fire goes out to smoke on 'पूजा' and his seated figure fades grey.
two_shot pan_left: Shiva turns on 'मुड़े' toward the ketaki lying on the ground and roars at it on 'गरजे'.
close push_in: Close on the ketaki cowering in shame; its bracts begin to brown and droop on 'झूठी'.
medium tilt_down: The ketaki withers completely and its petals fall away on 'चढ़ाएगा'; Shiva turns his face away in the background.
wide crane_down: A temple today: a sage offers flowers at a glowing Shiva altar while a withered ketaki lies set aside.
medium dolly_right: The sage looks at the withered ketaki, shakes his head and turns back to the altar on 'नहीं'.
wide pull_out: Dusk over still water: Brahma sits alone on his lotus, small and quiet.
medium push_in: Brahma on his lotus in a gold cosmos, orbs of worlds leaving his hands on 'रची'.
medium pull_out: The gold cosmos drains to grey on 'झूठ'; Brahma lowers his arms and grieves.
medium dolly_left: A memory in sepia: Brahma holds the ketaki forward before the pillar.
close push_in: Close on Brahma's face in cold shadow, eyes wide with fear on 'डर'.
medium crane_down: Vishnu in soft gold light with folded hands, calm and unashamed.
medium pan_left: Brahma sits on his lotus with head bowed as mist curls around him in a grey sky.
two_shot push_in: A memory: the sage Narada with his veena points in anger at Brahma, his name appearing on 'नारद'.
medium dutch: A red memory: Shiva in rage before Brahma whose fifth head glows on top, a red flash on 'सिर'.
insert tilt_down: The withered ketaki lies in Brahma's open hand, a dim grey light over it.
wide crane_up: Brahma sits alone on a dark violet void, three faint threads tying him to three faint lights behind: the three falls.
medium push_in: A golden balance: a crown on one pan rises on 'जीतने' while the other pan with a dark shadow sinks on 'डर', Brahma between them.
wide dolly_right: Shiva walks away to the right toward the snowy mountains, trishul in hand.
ots pan_left: Over a dark rock in the foreground, a figure watches Shiva's back from the left with narrowed eyes on 'घूर'.
close push_in: Close on Daksha, his name appears; tears roll from his eyes on 'आँखें'.
close static: Daksha's face hardens from grief to anger as embers rise around him in a red glow on 'जल'.
medium dutch: Daksha stands and points after Shiva with clenched rage on 'काटा', then on 'छीन' his face twists with hatred.
wide pull_out: A red wave of energy pulses out from Daksha's chest in a blood-red void.
medium crane_down: Dark smoke rises around Daksha until he is a dark silhouette in the red light.
wide push_in: Calm dawn over the valley: Brahma stands still and looks out toward the viewer.
medium pan_right: Brahma holds the ketaki and looks at it, unsure.
medium crane_down: Vishnu bows with folded hands in soft blue light, the image of the honest choice.
low_angle dutch: Brahma holds the flower high with a sly smile, red light rising behind him on 'झूठ'.
medium pull_out: Narada smiles with his veena on a sunny cloud and opens a hand to the viewer.
wide push_in: A dark crowned asura stands as a silhouette before a palace gate at dusk; the light rises on 'असुर'.
two_shot dolly_left: The asura faces Indra across the frame; Indra raises his vajra in alarm.
medium push_in: The asura smiles and opens his arms wide; a warm glow fills his chest on 'दिल'.
two_shot pan_right: Villagers plead before the asura and he gives with open hands, nodding yes.
wide pull_out: At dusk the asura bows low and his crown slips away, the light fading.
